evidence.title: Prompt-Conditioned Channel Attention for Hierarchical Feature Modulation toward Anatomy-Agnostic Segmentation

summary: Researchers introduced a hierarchical feature modulation framework that leverages prompt‑conditioned channel attention to improve segmentation across different anatomical structures without needing organ‑specific training. The approach enables a single model to generalize across varied medical imaging datasets, potentially streamlining clinical workflows.
title: New AI technique uses prompt‑conditioned channel attention for anatomy‑agnostic medical image segmentation
